newsitem.title: UK: Status Quo's Rick Parfitt has heart surgery.
newsitem.headline: Status Quo's Rick Parfitt has heart surgery.

text.p: Rick Parfitt of veteran British rock band Status Quo was recovering on Thursday after undergoing an emergency quadruple heart bypass operation.
The 48-year-old guitarist was being treated at London's Wellington Hospital after the four-hour operation on Wednesday night, a band spokesman said.
Major hits of Status Quo's 30-year career include "Pictures of Matchstick Men", "Down, Down", "Whatever You Want" and "Rockin' All Over The World".
Parfitt was admitted to hospital after complaining of chest pains. He was expected to remain in intensive care until Friday and doctors said he would make a full recovery.
